name: deepx_generate_image
description: Generate 1 to 4 images on Google Flow using Imagen 3 (NARWHAL) with support for reference assets, prompt styling, and 100% completion waiting.

prompt.description: The descriptive prompt for image generation.

reference_media_ids.description: Optional reference media IDs to blend or guide styling.

wait_for_render.description: If true (default), waits for the image tile to reach 100% completion in Google Flow before returning.
